dfz7nkcpg48xfINSERT INTO GLBTRNVALIDRES(ACMASTCODE, AC_NO, MSGCD, MSGDESCR, WARNINGMSG) SELECT :"SYS_B_00", :"SYS_B_01", :"SYS_B_02", :"SYS_B_03"||NAME||:"SYS_B_04"||ACCNT||:"SYS_B_05"||TOTODAMT, :"SYS_B_06" FROM ( SELECT A.ACCNT, A.TOTODAMT, A.GMST_CODE, B.NAME FROM ( SELECT :"SYS_B_07", :"SYS_B_08", COUNT(DISTINCT B.ACMASTCODE*:"SYS_B_09"+B.AC_NO) AS ACCNT, SUM(DECODE(NVL(B.OVERDUEAMT, :"SYS_B_10"), :"SYS_B_11", NVL(B.PEND_INST, :"SYS_B_12"), NVL(B.OVERDUEAMT, :"SYS_B_13"))) AS TOTODAMT, B.GMST_CODE FROM VIEWLNMAS B WHERE NVL(B.CLOSED, :"SYS_B_14") <> :"SYS_B_15" AND NVL(B.POST, :"SYS_B_16")= :"SYS_B_17" AND B.GMST_CODE=:"SYS_B_18" GROUP BY B.GMST_CODE HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT B.ACMASTCODE*:"SYS_B_19"+B.AC_NO)>:"SYS_B_20" ) A , BANKMAS B WHERE A.GMST_CODE=B.GMST_CODE AND NVL(A.TOTODAMT, :"SYS_B_21")>:"SYS_B_22" )

fdcytjj3g2a2xINSERT INTO GLBKARV.TMPFRMTRN6 (GMST_CODE, OTHGMST, NRECNO, FORM60_61) SELECT DISTINCT A.GMST_CODE AS GMST_CODE, C.GMST_CODE AS OTHGMST, B.NRECNO, C.FRM60_61 FROM GLBKARV.TMPFRMTRN7 A, BANKMAS C , GLBKARV.TMPFRMTRN5 B WHERE :"SYS_B_00"=:"SYS_B_01" AND A.GMST_CODE=B.GMST_CODE AND ( ( ( DECODE(NVL(C.LINKGMST, :"SYS_B_02"), :"SYS_B_03", LTRIM(RTRIM(LPAD(NVL(UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(C.PANNO))), TO_CHAR(NVL(C.LINKGMST, C.GMST_CODE))), :"SYS_B_04", :"SYS_B_05"))), LTRIM(RTRIM(LPAD(NVL(TO_CHAR(NVL(C.LINKGMST, C.GMST_CODE)), UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(C.PANNO)))), :"SYS_B_06", :"SYS_B_07"))) ) = LTRIM(RTRIM(A.SRCHGRPID)) ) OR ( UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(C.PANNO))) IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(C.PANNO)))= LTRIM(RTRIM(A.SRCHPANID)) ) ) ) UNION SELECT DISTINCT A.GMST_CODE AS GMST_CODE, C.GMST_CODE AS OTHGMST, B.NRECNO, C.FRM60_61 FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT A.GMST_CODE, NVL(B.LINKGMST, B.GMST_CODE) AS SRCHLINKGMST FROM BANKMAS B, GLBKARV.TMPFRMTRN7 A WHERE NVL(B.PANNO(+), :"SYS_B_08") = NVL(A.SRCHPANID, :"SYS_B_09") AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(B.PANNO(+)))) IS NOT NULL AND NVL(B.LINKGMST(+), :"SYS_B_10") !=:"SYS_B_11" AND NVL(B.LINKGMST(+), B.GMST_CODE(+)) != A.GMST_CODE ) A, BANKMAS C , GLBKARV.TMPFRMTRN5 B WHERE :"SYS_B_12"=:"SYS_B_13" AND A.GMST_CODE=B.GMST_CODE AND ( NVL(C.LINKGMST, :"SYS_B_14")= NVL(A.SRCHLINKGMST, :"SYS_B_15") AND NVL(C.LINKGMST, :"SYS_B_16")<>:"SYS_B_17" )
fkszph40q7xknINSERT INTO GLBTMPACBK (TDATE, AC_NO, DRCR, CSH_TRN, PRTCLS, DEBIT, CREDIT, BALANCE, DOC_NO, ACMASTCODE, PASS, POST, CTRNNO, OTRNNO, VOU_NO, VOU_SRNO, OP_ID , SU_ID, RC_COUNT, FD_COUNT, CHQ_PREFIX, CASHIER_ID, CASHIER_OK, CASH_CR, CASH_DR, CSHR_EXCP, DENMTION , REF_ACNO, REF_ACMCD , CHQBOUNCE, FORBRANCH, ATBRANCH, VOU_GRNO , DD_GRNO, GOLD_REC_NO, DD_CLEAR, INTFRDT, INTTODT, AC_TYPE, RECEIPTNO, FD_RC_CNT , SHIFT_NO, PROC_SRNO, AC_CODE, TRNSCNID) SELECT A.TDATE, A.AC_NO, A.DRCR, A.CSH_TRN, A.PRTCLS, A.DEBIT, A.CREDIT, A.BALANCE, A.DOC_NO, A.ACMASTCODE, :"SYS_B_00", A.POST, A.CTRNNO, A.OTRNNO, A.VOU_NO, A.VOU_SRNO, A.OP_ID , A.SU_ID, A.RC_COUNT, A.FD_COUNT, A.CHQ_PREFIX, A.CASHIER_ID, A.CASHIER_OK, A.CASH_CR, A.CASH_DR, A.CSHR_EXCP, A.DENMTION , A.REF_ACNO, A.REF_ACMCD , A.CHQBOUNCE, A.FORBRANCH, A.ATBRANCH, A.VOU_GRNO , A.DD_GRNO, A.GOLD_REC_NO, A.DD_CLEAR, A.INTFRDT, A.INTTODT, A.AC_TYPE, A.RECEIPTNO, A.FD_RC_CNT , A.SHIFT_NO, A.PROC_SRNO, B.AC_CODE, A.TRNSCNID FROM ACBK A, ACMAST B WHERE A.ACMASTCODE=B.ACMASTCODE AND A.TDATE = :"SYS_B_01" AND ATBRANCH = :"SYS_B_02" AND NVL(A.CNCLED, :"SYS_B_03") !=:"SYS_B_04" AND A.TRN_TYPE = :"SYS_B_05" AND A.CSH_TRN!= :"SYS_B_06" AND NVL(A.SSD_QUICK, :"SYS_B_07")=:"SYS_B_08" AND NVL(A.SRCOFTRN, :"SYS_B_09") NOT IN (:"SYS_B_10", :"SYS_B_11", :"SYS_B_12") AND NVL(A.POST, :"SYS_B_13")<>:"SYS_B_14" ORDER BY VOU_GRNO, OTRNNO

          ADDM Report for Task 'ADDM:4175398793_1_8809'

Analysis Period
---------------
AWR snapshot range from 8808 to 8809.
Time period starts at 05-JAN-26 03.30.03 PM
Time period ends at 05-JAN-26 04.30.24 PM

Analysis Target
---------------
Database 'KUBER' with DB ID 4175398793.
Database version during analysis period was 19.25.0.0.0.
Database version when ADDM was executed was 19.0.0.0.0.
All recommendations generated by ADDM are valid for database version 19.0.0.0.0, the version in which ADDM was executed.
ADDM performed an analysis of instance kuber, numbered 1 and hosted at
kuber-db.

Activity During the Analysis Period
-----------------------------------
Total database time was 26445 seconds.
The average number of active sessions was 7.3.

Summary of Findings
-------------------
   Description                      Active Sessions      Recommendations
                                    Percent of Activity
   -------------------------------  -------------------  ---------------
1  Session Connect and Disconnect   1.37 | 18.8          1
2  Soft Parse                       .87 | 11.91          2
3  Top SQL Statements               .45 | 6.12           2
4  Hard Parse Due to Invalidations  .42 | 5.69           1

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

          Findings and Recommendations
          ----------------------------

Finding 1: Session Connect and Disconnect
Impact is 1.37 active sessions, 18.8% of total activity.
--------------------------------------------------------
Session connect and disconnect calls were consuming significant database time.

   Recommendation 1: Application Analysis
   Estimated benefit is 1.37 active sessions, 18.8% of total activity.
   -------------------------------------------------------------------
   Action
      Investigate application logic for possible reduction of connect and
      disconnect calls. For example, you might use a connection pool scheme in
      the middle tier.


Finding 2: Soft Parse
Impact is .87 active sessions, 11.91% of total activity.
--------------------------------------------------------
Soft parsing of SQL statements was consuming significant database time.

   Recommendation 1: Application Analysis
   Estimated benefit is .87 active sessions, 11.91% of total activity.
   -------------------------------------------------------------------
   Action
      Investigate application logic to keep open the frequently used cursors.
      Note that cursors are closed by both cursor close calls and session
      disconnects.

   Recommendation 2: Database Configuration
   Estimated benefit is .87 active sessions, 11.91% of total activity.
   -------------------------------------------------------------------
   Action
      Consider increasing the session cursor cache size by increasing the
      value of parameter "session_cached_cursors".
   Rationale
      The value of parameter "session_cached_cursors" was "1000" during the
      analysis period.


Finding 3: Top SQL Statements
Impact is .45 active sessions, 6.12% of total activity.
-------------------------------------------------------
SQL statements consuming significant database time were found. These
statements offer a good opportunity for performance improvement.

   Recommendation 1: SQL Tuning
   Estimated benefit is .29 active sessions, 3.98% of total activity.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------
   Action
      Investigate the PL/SQL statement with SQL_ID "56980hjqxb68r" for
      possible performance improvements. You can supplement the information
      given here with an ASH report for this SQL_ID.
      Related Object
         SQL statement with SQL_ID 56980hjqxb68r.
         BEGIN PKG_COMMON_PROC.PROC_SETENV(:1,:2); END;
   Rationale
